network_status.network: Crollato il viadotto sul fiume Paglia, i piloni gravemente dissestati
network_status.summary_it: La fonte colloca il crollo del viadotto sul Paglia al 2 marzo 2020 e segnala che l'opera era già chiusa per il grave dissesto dei piloni; il record ARCUS riporta invece 2 maggio 2020. Finché la data non è corretta, non è ammissibile associare una finestra idrometrica al cedimento.
network_status.summary_en: The source dates collapse of the Paglia viaduct to 2 March 2020 and reports that it had already been closed because of severely distressed piers, whereas the ARCUS record gives 2 May 2020. No hydrometric window can be associated until the date is corrected.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
